additional_info.subject: RE: ID0391308-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P6 170000697] FailsafeMode CRM:00797001474
additional_info.body:
Hello RC-FR Team,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
ENGIE (France)
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / P6 170000697
Charger ID/Serial No.:
TmguWp
Problem Description:
FailsafeMode is active.
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since [
7th June 2024
], as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Upon checking an active error flag on the SCB, we noticed that the charger is in Failsafe Mode. We performed a remote reboot of the charger, but it not returned back to SCB online. Please refer to the following possible reasons for FailsafeMode being active:
Based on the logs and the issue reported by the customer, it appears that there is a problem with the XF4 router. We recommend initially checking all parameters of the XF4 router, such as the 24-volt power supply, LAN cables, etc. Additionally, we recommend carrying a spare router in case a replacement is needed.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0391308-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P6 170000697] FailsafeMode CRM:00797001474
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I went on site today and even if the charger is online actually, there is a problem with the router 1 (Siemens). Indeed, each time I do a reboot of the charger remotely, the charger gets back the communication on router 2 very well, but not on the router 1 in which we can see written “SIM CARD not inserted” on the teltonika overview. So I need each time to connect to the router and do a “register” on the mobile connection to get back the SCB communication.
I think there is a problem with the router 1, so can you plan to change it please with a new one (and maybe the SIM Card with it) ?
Thank you,
Best Regards,
Yacine Kedia
